_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "If the retail price of a Product is listed in a currency other than United States Dollars (USD), Gumroad will calculate a USD price based upon an exchange rate determined by Gumroad. Gumroad uses exchange rates obtained from http://openexchangerates.org/api. Gumroad cannot and does not guarantee that the exchange rate displayed reflects the most up to date rate due to the fluctuating nature of exchange rates. Accordingly, Gumroad recommends that you confirm current rates before engaging in any transactions on the Platform. Regardless of listed currency, all transactions through the Services will settle in USD."
_extraction_context.subject_exact: Gumroad Terms of Service (gumroad.com/terms, effective January 1, 2025, updated December 10, 2024) states non-USD prices are converted to USD using exchange rates from openexchangerates.org; Gumroad does not guarantee rates are current due to fluctuation; all transactions settle in USD regardless of listed currency
local_qualifiers: Gumroad ToS (eff. Jan 1, 2025): non-USD prices converted via openexchangerates.org; rates not guaranteed current; all transactions settle in USD regardless of listed currency
parser_notes: gumroad.com/terms (eff. Jan 1, 2025, updated Dec 10, 2024). ToS: FX conversion via openexchangerates.org; exchange rates not guaranteed current; USD settlement for all transactions.
